analysis.title: Vibrant Music Player Landing Page
analysis.notes: A white landing-page canvas centers a large cyan music-player interface, backed by faint utility graphics and overlapping colorful app surfaces. Rounded corners, aqua wave bands, saturated accent colors, and a partially cropped black headline create a polished but playful product-presentation aesthetic.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a polished landing-page hero for a futuristic music player: a large rounded cyan-blue application window centered on a clean white canvas, with vivid turquoise wave shapes flowing across its lower section, a small abstract iridescent album-art tile near the top center, and a dark teal rounded playback control floating in front. Add subtle pale interface glyphs and colorful rounded panels behind it, soft shadows, generous whitespace, crisp sans-serif micro-labels, and a partially cropped oversized black headline at the bottom. No logos, brand names, or readable text.
